items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: Cork O'Keefe comes to manage the band and I think he booked the band on the road trip and he had a desk in the office and he and I roomed together.

ctx.x: Now this is the spring of '28?
This is the spring of '27. Still '27 and Cork O'Keefe comes to manage the band and I think he booked the band on the road trip and he had a desk in the office and he and I roomed together.
Where did he work out of? Detroit.
